notes: Operative report. Procedure: L4-L5 laminectomy with bilateral foraminotomies; posterior spinal instrumentation L4-S1 (pedicle screws bilateral L4, L5, S1; titanium rods); posterolateral arthrodesis L4-S1 with local autograft and allograft. Findings: grade 2 L5-S1 isthmic spondylolisthesis, severe L4-5 stenosis. Complications: small incidental durotomy at L5, repaired primarily with suture and fibrin sealant; no postoperative CSF leak. Anesthesia: GA, ETT, uneventful. EBL 450 mL. Skin incision midline L3 to S1.
One-year follow-up: solid fusion, back pain improved, residual mild numbness lateral R foot. Released to activity as tolerated.

Labor epidural. History of lumbar fusion (no imaging available). Midline scar L3-S1. Attempts at L3-4 x 3 (bone contact, no LOR); placed at L2-3 on 4th attempt, LOR 6 cm. Asymmetric block, left > right, T10. Catheter withdrawn 1 cm and bolused: unchanged. Replaced at L2-3 by attending (J. Moreno, MD) at 0905: improved but patchy right sacral sparing. Recommend early placement by attending with ultrasound in future pregnancies.

28 weeks. Mallampati II, TMD > 6 cm, good mouth opening, BMI 37. Asthma controlled. Noted: hemorrhage in 2022 treated with carboprost, followed by wheezing and SpO2 88% requiring albuterol - avoid carboprost. Spine: well-healed midline scar L3-S1; spinous processes palpable above L3 only. Prior L4-S1 fusion with L4-5 laminectomy; 2022 epidural difficult and patchy. Plan: request outside op note and imaging; early epidural in labor by attending, ultrasound-guided level identification, enter at L2-3 or above (above the fusion and laminectomy), consider CSE or dural puncture epidural to confirm midline placement; warn re: patchy/unilateral block and higher dural puncture risk; document baseline neuro exam (R L5 numbness). Counseled on early epidural.
